metadata.description: Keel — lay the foundational documentation suite for a greenfield software project through a guided, multi-persona interview.

plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Interview the founder about a new project idea, then generate the right set of foundational docs (CLAUDE.md, BRD, PRD, ARCHITECTURE, LLD, ADR, NFR, and more) ready to build from with Claude Code. Also keeps them current (/keel upgrade), light (/keel archive), and lets you check what version is installed (/keel version).
